# GCC -fanalyzer findings in the library sources (src/) on main, counted by
# file and warning. The Static analysis workflow fails when a file reports
# more findings of a warning than listed here, and asks for the count to be
# lowered when it reports fewer. Each group says what its findings report.
#
# <count> <file> <warning>

# xqc_stream_send() logs and returns ret uninitialized when it is called
# with no data and no FIN.
2 src/common/xqc_log.h -Wanalyzer-use-of-uninitialized-value
1 src/transport/xqc_stream.c -Wanalyzer-use-of-uninitialized-value

# xqc_write_http_priority() writes its FEC value into an unchecked calloc()
# result, and leaks it when dstcap is too small.
2 src/common/xqc_str.h -Wanalyzer-possible-null-dereference
1 src/http3/xqc_h3_request.c -Wanalyzer-malloc-leak

# xqc_h3_frm_parse_setting() stores a setting through entries on a path
# where entries is NULL.
1 src/http3/frame/xqc_h3_frame.c -Wanalyzer-null-dereference

# xqc_engine_unregister_alpn() compares the bytes of alpn_reg->alpn before
# it checks it for NULL.
1 src/transport/xqc_engine.c -Wanalyzer-deref-before-check

# xqc_try_process_fec_decode() reads the repair symbol that
# xqc_get_rpr_syb() returns as NULL.
1 src/transport/xqc_frame_parser.c -Wanalyzer-null-dereference

# xqc_recv_timestamps_info_create() writes to its calloc() result before it
# checks it.
1 src/transport/xqc_recv_timestamps_info.c -Wanalyzer-possible-null-dereference

# xqc_wt_h3_init_settings() uses the context that xqc_wt_ctx_get() returns
# as NULL.
1 src/webtransport/xqc_webtransport_ctx.c -Wanalyzer-null-dereference

# xqc_wt_stream_abort() releases a stream that the release in
# xqc_wt_stream_notify_close() may already have freed.
1 src/webtransport/xqc_webtransport_stream.c -Wanalyzer-use-after-free
